items: They show variable oxidation states because they can lose different numbers of electrons to form stable ions, e.g. Fe2+ and Fe3+.
They readily form coordination compounds (complexes) by accepting lone pairs of electrons from ligands into vacant d orbitals.
They form coloured ions and complexes, because electrons move from a lower to a higher energy level when light is absorbed.
The metals and their compounds act as catalysts, because they can easily change their oxidation states.
